title: Equilibrium Transition and Cartel Formation: A Structural Analysis of Chile's Pharmacy Cartel
abstract: arXiv:2609.14487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies how Chile's three largest pharmacy chains moved from the price war to collusion, using court-record daily prices and a structural model. After a court-ordered advertisement ban ended the comparison campaign, the estimated gain from loss-leader pricing fell sharply, weakening the incentive to continue the price war. The chains then used an upstream supplier as intermediary to verify a collusive price-leadership procedure. Once verified, they applied it to restore margins on former loss leaders. They then raised prices further to extract rents. These increases spread more slowly than margin restoration. The Adaptive Confidence specification allows a subjective belief about follower participation to update. It more closely matches the cumulative spread of rent extraction than the Unit Confidence specification. Unit Confidence imposes the rational-belief benchmark by fixing the leader's weight at one.

translated_title: 均衡转变与卡特尔形成：智利药店卡特尔的结构性分析
translated_abstract: 本文利用法庭记录的每日价格数据和结构模型，研究了智利三大连锁药店如何从价格战转向合谋。在法院下令禁止广告并终结比价宣传战后，亏本引流定价的估计收益急剧下降，削弱了继续价格战的激励。随后，这些连锁店利用一家上游供应商作为中介，验证了一种合谋的价格领导程序。验证完成后，它们将其应用于恢复原先亏本引流商品的利润率，进而进一步提价以攫取租金，而这些提价的扩散速度慢于利润率的恢复。自适应置信设定允许关于跟随者参与情况的主观信念进行更新，相比将领导者权重固定为1、从而施加理性信念基准的单位置信设定，它能更好地匹配租金攫取的累积扩散过程。
tldr: 本文利用结构模型和法庭记录的每日价格数据，分析了智利三大连锁药店从价格战转向合谋的过程，发现广告禁令削弱了价格战激励后，药店通过上游供应商中介验证了合谋价格领导机制，先恢复亏损商品的利润率再进一步提价攫取租金。
en_tdlr: Using a structural model and court-recorded daily prices, this paper analyzes how Chile's three largest pharmacy chains transitioned from price war to collusion, showing that an advertising ban weakened price war incentives, after which the chains verified a collusive price-leadership scheme through an upstream supplier to restore margins on former loss leaders and then extract additional rents.
